frame: One person standing alone, whole figure, front view, same size on the page, on a plain ground line with a plain low wall and a small bench behind. Same simple clothes. Only the age of the person changes: body size, hair and face lines.
sentence_nl: Dit kind is jong, maar die man is oud.
sentence_en: This child is young, but that man is old.

frame: One plain drinking glass without a handle standing alone on a bare table, side view, same size on the page, a plain wall behind. A small jug stands beside it as a reference. Only the amount of water in the glass changes.
sentence_nl: Dit glas is vol, maar dat glas is leeg.
sentence_en: This glass is full, but that glass is empty.

frame: One small adult standing at the left on a ground line, whole figure, same size, side view, with a plain white sky behind. One plain wall stands at the right. Only the height of the wall changes.
sentence_nl: Deze muur is hoog, maar die muur is laag.
sentence_en: This wall is high, but that wall is low.

frame: One plain cup on a bare table, side view, same size on the page, a plain wall behind, one hand-sized spoon beside it, and one forearm and hand reaching in from the right. Only the temperature signs and the hand change: steam lines, or ice cubes and frost marks.
sentence_nl: De eerste thee is heet, de tweede is warm en de derde is koud.
sentence_en: The first tea is hot, the second is warm and the third is cold.

frame: One adult standing on a ground line, side view, whole figure, same size, same stance, a plain wall behind, carrying one plain cardboard box in both arms. Only the weight of the box changes: the body bends under it, or stands straight.
sentence_nl: Deze doos is zwaar, maar die doos is licht.
sentence_en: This box is heavy, but that box is light.

frame: One plain chair seen from the side, standing on a ground line with a plain wall behind, same size on the page. A small cat sits on the seat. Only the seat changes: a flat plank, or a thick rounded cushion.
sentence_nl: Deze stoel is hard, maar die stoel is zacht.
sentence_en: This chair is hard, but that chair is soft.

frame: One adult man standing on a ground line, side view, whole figure, same size, a plain wall behind, one small plain wooden stool on the ground in front of him. Only the arms and the stool change: thick arms and the stool held high in one hand, or thin arms and the stool still on the ground.
sentence_nl: Deze man is sterk, maar die man is zwak.
sentence_en: This man is strong, but that man is weak.

frame: One person's face and shoulders, front view, same size on the page, a plain white background. White outlined face with simple eyes, brows and mouth, same round head and same short hair. Only the brows, the eyes and the mouth change.
sentence_nl: Eerst is hij blij, dan is hij verdrietig en dan is hij boos.
sentence_en: First he is happy, then he is sad and then he is angry.

frame: One adult woman sitting on a plain chair at a bare table, front view, upper body only, same size, a plain wall behind, a plain cup, a blanket and a thermometer with no numerals or scale marks. Only the posture, the blanket and the thermometer's place change.
sentence_nl: Gisteren was ik ziek, maar vandaag ben ik gezond.
sentence_en: Yesterday I was ill, but today I am healthy.

frame: One adult in the water at the left, side view, a plain shore at the right and a plain sky, the bottom drawn as a line. Same size on the page, wavy surface line. Only the depth of the water against the body changes.
sentence_nl: Het water is hier diep, maar daar is het ondiep.
sentence_en: The water is deep here, but it is shallow there.

frame: One adult standing on a ground line at the left, side view, whole figure, same size, a plain white sky. One plain house with a door stands at the right. Only the gap between the person and the house changes.
sentence_nl: Dit huis is dichtbij, maar dat huis is ver weg.
sentence_en: This house is near, but that house is far away.
